title: Complete 3D Projection Gizmo
description: Rebuild the ad-hoc corner orbit gizmo into a complete projection navigation control: face/corner/center cube emitting WorldProjectionSpec, plus a family switcher exposing every taxonomy kind, with fixed snap pipeline so all transitions land correctly.
summary: Added lower navigation-cube corners (NE↓/NW↓/SE↓/SW↓) alongside upper corners. Corner hits now carry hemisphere upper|lower; axonometric WorldProjectionSpec accepts optional hemisphere and computeWorldProjectionPose flips the view below the target for lower corners. WGPU gizmo paint draws all eight corner markers. Tests: 120 passed in infinite-world-r3f.
